description: This file defines the Java entity class 'ProductReviewEntity' representing product reviews in the system. It includes fields for description, product ID, date, and rating, along with validation annotations and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ProductReviewEntity
classes.description: A Java entity class representing a product review, extending ShopEntity and implementing Serializable. It encapsulates review details such as description, product ID, date, and rating.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with the review.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with the review.
